releasePlan.notes: Flag gates the ENTER CALLSIGN login overlay in init(). v1 treatment shows the login screen and captures a player callsign; control restores the original pre-PR welcome overlay (showOverlay call) with no callsign capture. Flag evaluation is deferred until after await initLaunchDarkly() so the variation check is safe. loginOverlay is display:none in HTML markup — control users never see a flash. The restartGame() guard (loginOverlay.style.display='none') is preserved under both paths as a defensive no-op. No prerequisites required.

releaseIntent._instructions: Human approver: edit freely. action: auto (release on deploy) | hold (do not release yet) | manual (a human runs the release). Structured fields execute; anything else goes in notes (an agent will structure it on the PR for your review). Blank fields = default auto-release on deploy. prerequisites: [{"flagKey": "flag-xyz", "variation": "on"}]. notBefore: YYYY-MM-DD. reference: ticket/doc URL.
